blueprint.title: Product blueprint drawing set
blueprint.crumbs: Where you are on the plan
blueprint.sheets_more_before: {count} more sheets before these, show them
blueprint.sheets_more_after: {count} more sheets after these, show the next
blueprint.depth: Depth, the same levels as the plan
blueprint.figure_desc: The plan of the product: {features} features in {wings} wings, {waiting} waiting for a decision.
blueprint.chrono_rule: Left to right: wings in the order work began, features oldest first
blueprint.names_hint_short: Feature names drawn. The rest are off the sheet or too small: zoom, or press Enter.
blueprint.names_hint_all: Every feature name on the sheet is drawn.
blueprint.queue_toggle: Show or hide the Build queue
blueprint.queue_empty: Nothing waiting in {place}. Esc climbs to a wider place.
blueprint.off_plan_open: Open the ledger to see the findings whose feature is not on the plan
blueprint.next_executing: The runner reports back to this sheet
blueprint.next_rework: The next run reads the note
blueprint.armed_hint: B or Enter starts the build, Esc disarms. Only approved items go.
blueprint.say_pick: Pick an item first: J walks the waiting work.
blueprint.say_nothing_build: Nothing approved. A approves; only B builds, and only approved items.
blueprint.say_armed: Armed to build. Items: {items}, jobs: {jobs}. B or Enter starts, Esc disarms.
blueprint.say_enter_hint: A approves, X declines this item.
blueprint.say_agents: Agents running: {running}. Runs in the store: {runs}.
blueprint.find_scope: Wings, bays, features and waiting work
blueprint.find_placeholder: Find a feature, a place or a waiting item
blueprint.find_none: No match in {product}. Try a wing letter, a bay code or a word from a title.
blueprint.reason_for: {lens}. The reason is kept as the note on the decision.
blueprint.reason_placeholder: A reason the next person can act on
blueprint.key_next: Next waiting item; the camera follows
blueprint.key_find: Find a feature, a place or a waiting item
blueprint.key_approve: Approve the current item. Never builds
blueprint.key_build: Build the approved: arms first, B or Enter starts
blueprint.key_enter: Down one level; at the bay opens the feature
blueprint.key_back: Up one level; at the site, closes the drawing set
blueprint.key_lens: 1 the General sheet, 2 to 9 a lens sheet
blueprint.tip_waiting: Waiting here: {count}. Double click to open.
blueprint.plain_flagged: Live for some users, behind a switch
blueprint.scan_heading: The scan on this feature · waiting: {count}
blueprint.opt_decline_sub: Stays in the backlog as declined, with your reason
blueprint.opt_arm_sub: Nothing builds until you press B, and B again or Enter starts it
blueprint.evidence_none: No before or after reading filed for this item.
blueprint.pg_tabs_label: Feature page tabs (the plan's lens follows)
blueprint.pg_progress_nr: Progress: not recorded for that date
blueprint.pg_rollout_nr: Rollout: not recorded for that date
blueprint.pg_not_on_drawing: Not on the drawing yet on {date}
blueprint.pg_asof_note: The stage and measured readings are those of that date; what has no history is marked not recorded. Other sections show the current record.
blueprint.pg_plain_past: on {date}. How it was doing then is not recorded.
blueprint.pg_plain_rollout: Live for {pct} of users, behind a switch
blueprint.pg_read_on: Read on {date}. Health is not recorded for that date.
blueprint.pg_nr_section: Evidence and the other fields are not kept by date. Measured metrics below show their readings up to {date}.
blueprint.pg_na_here: This lens does not apply here.
blueprint.pg_stands_alone: Nothing, it stands on its own
blueprint.pg_code_no_paths: No file paths recorded for this context.
blueprint.pg_activity_some: Recent activity · latest {shown} of {count}, back to {date}
blueprint.pg_hero_na: This lens does not apply to this feature.
blueprint.pg_hero_none: No {lens} reading for this feature yet.
blueprint.pg_hero_ok: No rule raised anything: it reads {health}.
blueprint.pg_one_run: One run has this screen: compare needs two.
blueprint.pg_swipe_label: Swipe between run A (left) and run B (right)
blueprint.key_accept: Accept the built item: it rides the next release
blueprint.key_rework: Send it back to rework, with a note for the next attempt
blueprint.key_descope: Descope it, with a note saying why
blueprint.key_reopen: Undo the last triage: back to the status it had
blueprint.reason_note_required: a failed build is accepted only with a note
blueprint.reason_no_prior_status: no earlier status recorded, nothing to undo
blueprint.note_q_rework: What should the next attempt change?
blueprint.note_for: {lens}. The note is kept on the item as its triage note.
blueprint.note_placeholder: A note the next person or run can act on
blueprint.cmp_not_found: This item is no longer in the store.
blueprint.cmp_failed: It did not build, broke a gate or did not move its metric. The store accepts it only with a note.
blueprint.cmp_pt_key_band: noise: the larger of the spread and one frame ({ms} ms)
blueprint.cmp_pt_why_none: No after reading yet: the item cannot be judged.
blueprint.cmp_pt_why_flat: The change ({change}) against the median of {runs} baseline runs is not larger than the noise (±{noise}), so it is within noise: a lucky run looks like this.
blueprint.cmp_pt_why_moved: The change ({change}) against the median of {runs} baseline runs is larger than the noise (±{noise}), so it moved.
blueprint.cmp_pt_why_worse: The change ({change}) against the median of {runs} baseline runs is larger than the noise (±{noise}), so it got worse.
blueprint.cmp_shots_none: No screens for this item: judge it by the metric, the evidence and the diff.
blueprint.cmp_slider_label: Slider: before on the left, after on the right
blueprint.cmp_commit_none: No commit recorded for this item.
blueprint.cmp_commit_none_failed: No commit: the build did not get that far.
blueprint.projects_none: No other product to switch to.
blueprint.level_tip_missing: No readable map: this product cannot be drawn
blueprint.rail_plan_title: Plan: sheet {sheet}, legend and features in trouble
blueprint.rail_view_title: View: the last {days} days, what changed, health
blueprint.agents_aborted_note: The run was stopped before it finished. Its lines below say how far it got.
blueprint.agents_start_note_waiting: A session of this build is alive but parked or in a state this sheet does not know. It needs a look in the Fleet.
blueprint.agents_start_note_failed: A session of this build ended badly. Its output is in the Fleet.
blueprint.agents_start_note_silent: No session of this build has reached the Fleet. It may still be queued, or the drive stopped before it started one.
blueprint.agents_ov_sub: how runs reach this sheet · latest lines
blueprint.changes_chip_label: {count} changed since you last looked, open the list
blueprint.agents_runs_label: Runs in the store, newest first
blueprint.agents_no_runs: No runs in the store yet. Approve findings and press B to build them.
blueprint.agents_no_started: Nothing started from this sheet yet. B starts a build of the approved items.
blueprint.agents_ended_badly: The run ended {status}. Its lines below say how far it got.
blueprint.agents_no_lines: The store has no lines for this run.
blueprint.agents_start_lede: Started from this sheet. Its sessions run in the fleet under this label and report to the store as they go.
blueprint.agents_ov_text: Personas starts a lens-scan run when you build approved findings (B). Each run writes its lines to the store; they show here as the store records them.
blueprint.agents_no_latest: Nothing yet. A run's lines show here as it reports.
blueprint.leg_strip: Along each fixture's top edge, one mark per lens, always in this order. Its colour is that lens's health.
blueprint.leg_unscanned: no lens has measured it yet: run a scan
blueprint.leg_note: Tile colour is always the stage. Each lens adds its own marks; on the General sheet all {count} enabled lenses show at once.
blueprint.leg_fill: = {what}: a {line} pattern from the left. A broken line on the top edge means not measured.
blueprint.leg_unknown: = not measured yet: run a scan
blueprint.plan_ov_sub: sheet {sheet} · trouble by lens · title block
blueprint.plan_none_lens: No feature is bad or to watch under {lens}.
blueprint.plan_none_any: No feature is bad or to watch under any lens.
blueprint.view_tip: J and K move between sections.
blueprint.view_w1_x: What moved since yesterday: the morning glance.
blueprint.view_w7_x: The week: what a weekly review should see.
blueprint.view_w14_x: Two weeks: a sprint, or catching up after time away.
blueprint.view_window_help: The window decides which tiles carry the changed mark, the title block's changed count and the list below.
blueprint.view_none_changed: No feature changed stage in this window.
blueprint.key_ledger: Switch between the drawing set and the findings ledger
blueprint.key_timeline: Open or close the timeline panel
blueprint.key_select: Add the current item to the selection, or take it out
blueprint.tl_slider: Time: drag along the revision history of {count} weeks to travel; the right end is now
blueprint.tl_value_still: one week of history, nothing earlier to travel to
blueprint.tl_kp_label: Key plan: press to move the camera there
blueprint.hov_not_yet: Not yet on the drawing at this date
blueprint.hov_flagged_pct: Live for {pct} of users, behind a switch
blueprint.hov_hint_tile: Click to open the full sheet · Shift+click picks its items
blueprint.hov_hint_place: Click or scroll to go inside
blueprint.dc_by: The {lens} lens asks for a decision on {feature}.
blueprint.dc_c_approve: Joins the approved list. Nothing builds until you press B.
blueprint.dc_c_decline: Closes it, with a reason you give.
blueprint.dc_c_build: Arms a build of every approved item; B or Enter starts it.
blueprint.dc_c_rework: Sends it back, with a note on what to change.
blueprint.dc_fx: The amber ring on the plan marks the feature it touches.
blueprint.lg_product_line: {product} · lens release train · {findings} findings · {items} items in {packs} packs
blueprint.lg_lenses_tip: Lenses are authored in bp: opens bp at this product
blueprint.lg_ev_no_shots: No screens: the harness cannot render this feature
blueprint.lg_ev_commit_label: Commit {sha}: its diff is in the compare panel
blueprint.lg_no_packs: A lens execute builds its approved findings into a pack on its own branch; its items land here to be accepted, sent back or descoped.
blueprint.lg_no_findings: No findings yet. A lens scan proposes them; they appear here as it does.
blueprint.lg_inbox_zero_body: Nothing proposed. New findings land here as scans propose them.
blueprint.lg_matrix_caption_packs: Pack items by feature and lens, by state
blueprint.lg_matrix_caption_backlog: Findings by feature and lens, counted by risk
blueprint.lg_table_tip: Read the findings on {name} in the triage table ({n})
blueprint.lg_pick_first: Focus or check a pack item first
blueprint.lg_why_undo: Nothing to undo: only accepted, rework or descoped items go back, until their release is built
blueprint.lg_sth_proposed: found by a scan, waiting for approval
blueprint.lg_sth_done: built and measured, waiting for you
blueprint.lg_sth_failed: did not build, broke a gate or did not move
blueprint.lg_sth_rework: back to the rework queue with a note
blueprint.lg_in_bp_tip: Releases are cut, built and finished in bp: opens the Release tab of bp at this product
blueprint.lg_undo_in_bp: The items of a release are undone in bp: opens the Release tab of bp
blueprint.lg_rel_to_triage: Accept items in the triage table
blueprint.lg_rel_wait_next: Accepted items waiting for the next release: {n} (v{v} is past draft).
blueprint.lg_rel_rework_none: Empty. Items sent back with R land here with their note.
blueprint.lg_rel_build_head: Build · Claude Code on your machine, your gh login
blueprint.lg_rel_failed_why: the release job did not get through
blueprint.lg_rel_hint_none: No release yet: accepted items wait here. A draft of them is cut in bp.
blueprint.lg_rel_hint_draft: A draft of {n} items: a decision on them can still be undone. Build when the package is right.
blueprint.lg_rel_hint_building: Claude Code is working on the release in bp.
blueprint.lg_rel_hint_pr_open: Merge the PR on GitHub, then Finish in bp.
blueprint.lg_rel_hint_merged: Merged. Finish tags v{v} and publishes the GitHub release.
blueprint.lg_rel_hint_failed: Retry the build once the cause is fixed; the package stays as it is.
blueprint.lg_rel_notes_preview: Release notes it will publish · preview
blueprint.lg_cmp_judgement: (a model re-read the code at each commit)
blueprint.lg_cmp_no_reading_failed: no reading: the build did not get that far
blueprint.lg_cmp_map_cap: Change map · {theme} · after, with changed pixels marked
blueprint.lg_cmp_no_screens: the harness cannot render this feature ({name}). Judge it by the metric, the evidence and the diff below.
blueprint.lg_pix_lone: Only a pair with a before and an after can be compared.
blueprint.lg_pix_identical: Identical: no pixel differs by more than {maxd} of 255 levels.
blueprint.lg_pix_near: Visually identical: {moved} of pixels shift by at most {maxd} of 255 levels.
blueprint.lg_pix_differ: {pct} of pixels differ; at most {maxd} of 255 levels.
blueprint.lg_pix_same_title: The screens show no designed difference.
blueprint.lg_pix_same_tail: The item designs a state the harness does not reach ({state}): the change is in the metric and the diff.

lens.open_effect: Opens the blueprint over the deck. Approve, decline and triage happen on the sheet.
lens.open_release_effect: Opens the release composition. bp composes and finishes the release.
lens.on_sheet_hint: This card never writes. Open it to decide on the blueprint sheet.
lens.error_store: The product store could not be read.
lens.error_registry: lens-scan is not installed for this product.
lens.error_node: Node.js is not on PATH, so lens-scan cannot run here.
lens.error_hint: Nothing on this sheet writes. Close it, fix the cause, and open the card again.
lens.tab_blueprint_hint: Every lens-scan product's drawing set. Open one to approve, decline and triage.
lens.picker_empty: No project holds a lens-scan store yet
lens.picker_empty_hint: A code project appears here once its repo has .ai/lens-scan/scan.db.
lens.picker_failed: The lens-scan products could not be read.
lens.level_tip_missing: Cannot be drawn: .ai/lens-scan/app-structure.json is missing or unreadable
lens.level_tip_map_only: The map draws; nothing is measured yet
lens.level_tip_measured: The map draws with lens-scan readings
lens.level_tip_full: Map, readings and the events log
lens.level_tip_unreadable: The scan store did not open, so nothing in it could be counted
lens.map_hint: Run /adopt-bp in that repo to create .ai/lens-scan/app-structure.json

build.title: {product}: build queue
build.body_proposed_one: 1 proposal waits for approve or decline.
build.body_proposed_other: {count} proposals wait for approve or decline.
build.body_approved_one: 1 approved item is not built yet.
build.body_approved_other: {count} approved items are not built yet.
build.body_open: Open the blueprint to walk the queue item by item.

evidence.title: {product}: built work to triage
evidence.body_one: 1 built item waits for triage: accept, rework or descope.
evidence.body_other: {count} built items wait for triage: accept, rework or descope.
evidence.body_open: The blueprint opens at the first feature of the pack, beside its compare panel.

release.title: {product}: release {version}
release.body_items_one: 1 accepted item waits for a release.
release.body_items_other: {count} accepted items wait for a release.
release.body_pr_open: Release {version} has an open pull request.
release.body_merged: Release {version} merged and is not finished yet.
release.body_bp: bp composes and finishes releases. This card opens the composition, read only.
release.sheet_read_only: Read only. bp composes and finishes the release.
release.from_none: No earlier release in the store
release.bump_minor: Minor bump: a baseline upgrade or a new capability is among the items.
release.bump_patch: Patch bump: no baseline upgrade or new capability.
release.items_none: No accepted item waits for a release.
release.notes_none: bp writes the notes when it composes the release.
release.bp_down_body: Start it in the root folder of bp, then open the release again:
